strongest_angle: Analyzing the October 2026 JLL global research findings detailing how 45% of organizations are scaling AI in facilities management, with projections reaching 86% by 2030 amidst skilled trades shortages.

key_facts.fact: According to JLL research, 45% of organizations are already scaling or optimizing artificial intelligence in facilities management globally, with projections reaching 86% by the year 2030.

JLL's Global State of Facilities Management Report surveyed 1,321 organizations across 15 countries, revealing that nearly 70% of organizations experienced disruptions due to skilled trades labor shortages.
JLL research indicates that 50% of global occupiers view facilities management as a driver of competitive advantage today, and that figure is set to surge to 82% by 2030.
CRE Daily reported that robotics adoption in facilities management is expected to climb from 37% to 71% by 2030 according to JLL findings.
